They are infrastructure-savvy; have an internal model routing layer and are evaluating Redwood as a drop-in inference tier to replace a portion of their internal fleet.

Key asks / product fit:
- IDE integrations (VS Code extension telemetry) + streaming with <100ms tail latencies for completions.

- Deployment: prefer Dedicated inside VPC for predictable throughput; acceptable hybrid with Hosted for burst.
